feeHashEncoding.formula: feeScheduleHash = keccak256(abi.encode(uint8 domainVersion, uint256 chainId, address escrow, bytes32 settlementUnitId, uint8 feeBasis, uint256 G, uint256 F, uint256 N, uint16 feeBps, uint256 denominator, uint8 roundingRule, address feeRecipient, bytes32 feeSplitConfigHash)) rendered "0x"+64hex
feeHashEncoding.wordLayout: each field right-aligned in its OWN 32-byte word (uintN left-padded big-endian; address = 12 zero bytes + 20-byte address; bytes32 as-is); 13 words = 416 bytes; then keccak_256
feeHashEncoding.feeMath: F == mulDiv(G, feeBps, 10000) floor (full-precision); N == G - F; N + F == G
feeHashEncoding.supersedes: the v0.2.2 3-field keccak256(abi.encode(uint16 feeBps, address feeRecipient, bytes32 feeSplit)) = 0x0fb8ce11... form
feeHashEncoding.note: feeScheduleHash: Hex32 | null in the type; these v0.2.3 fixtures always commit a schedule (even zero-fee), so it is never null here. settlementUnitId mapping to (jobId,milestoneIndex,stepId) + on-chain getters/freeze lifecycle are escrow-lane action items (9de363c7).

_meta.file: NEGATIVE conformance vectors (§17.7) — each is a fully-signed verdict rejected for exactly one reason
_meta.design: Each negative vector recomputes feeScheduleHash (13-field abi.encode) -> verdictHash (SHA-256/JCS) -> EIP-712 digest -> re-signs with the non-prod anvil#0 key; the signature recovers to 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266. The ONLY defect is named by expectedRejectReason, so each fails for exactly its intended reason (never a stale-hash artifact). feeScheduleHashSensitivity is a separate pure-computation table proving abi.encode binds all 13 fields.

vectors.name: encoding-abi-encodePacked
vectors.mutation: attested feeScheduleHash computed with abi.encodePacked (natural widths, no padding; 269 bytes) instead of abi.encode (416 bytes); schedule scalars are valid

eip712.typeString: Step10Verdict(bytes32 verdictHash,uint16 verdictSchemaVersion,uint256 chainId,address escrowAddress,bytes32 verifierSetIdHash)

expected.note: recompute feeScheduleHash13(feeSchedule) == committed abi.encode hash != attestedFeeScheduleHash (packed); the ONLY defect is the encoding of the attested hash
